nominal.$description: Normal / OK state. Nominal readings, confirmed-good, success.

active.$description: Selected / active mode, armed state, focus rings, live status.

target.$description: Managed / computed goal, automated set-point. Use sparingly.

caution.$description: Abnormal but not critical. Approaching limits, degraded, watch.

warning.$description: Limit exceeded / critical. Immediate action. Reserve strictly.

data.$description: Primary numeric readouts and live values. Brightest text.

label.$description: Labels, units, helper and secondary text. Never for values.

muted.$description: Disabled, placeholder, decorative separators. No meaning.

data-dim.$description: Faint metadata — timestamps, tick labels. Decorative; sits below muted.

border-strong.$description: Divider / stronger rule — heavier than the hairline border.
